templates.html:
<button type="button" class="btn-danger btn-danger--{{style}}" style="--bg:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>
  <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M4 7h16M9 7V4h6v3M6 7l1 13a2 2 0 002 2h6a2 2 0 002-2l1-13"/></svg> Delete {{itemLabel}}
</button>
<style>
.btn-danger {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  font: 700 15px/1 system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 11px 20px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bg);
  background: var(--bg);
  color: #FAF7F2;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-danger--outline { background: transparent; color: var(--bg); }
.btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.08); }
.btn-danger:active:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(0.92); }
.btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
.btn-danger:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
</style>
templates.tailwind:
<button type="button" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold border-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:brightness-110 active:brightness-90 btn-danger-tw btn-danger-tw--{{style}}" style="border-color:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>
  <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M4 7h16M9 7V4h6v3M6 7l1 13a2 2 0 002 2h6a2 2 0 002-2l1-13"/></svg> Delete {{itemLabel}}
</button>
<style>
.btn-danger-tw--solid { background: {{bg}}; color: #FAF7F2; }
.btn-danger-tw--outline { background: transparent; color: {{bg}}; }
.btn-danger-tw--{{style}}:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
</style>
